cohort: The study analyzed data from 2687 neonates born >=35 weeks gestational age and admitted to the well-baby nursery at a tertiary medical center in Southern Taiwan.
finding: A machine learning model (Random Forest) was successfully developed and implemented, demonstrating effective prediction of early neonatal hypoglycemia within four hours after birth, with an AUC of 0.732.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was identified as one of the top five predictors of neonatal hypoglycemia by the SHAP values.
cross-section timing: Data collected between 1 January 2011 and 31 August 2021
birth_weight: Birth weight < 2500 gm was identified as one of the top five predictors of neonatal hypoglycemia; specific inclusion/exclusion based on birth weight beyond this is not mentioned.
gest_age: Neonates included were born >=35 weeks gestational age; gestational age was also identified as one of the top five predictors of neonatal hypoglycemia.
